verses.original: שׁ֚וּבָה יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַ֖ד יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ כִּ֥י כָשַׁ֖לְתָּ בַּעֲוֺנֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: šû·b̲āh yiś·rā·’êl ‘aḏ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā kî ḵā·šal·tā ba·‘ă·wō·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: Return O Israel to the LORD your God for you have stumbled by your iniquity
verses.literalPt: Volta, ó Israel, para Jeová, teu Deus, pois caíste pela tua iniquidade.

verses.original: קְח֤וּ עִמָּכֶם֙ דְּבָרִ֔ים וְשׁ֖וּבוּ אֶל־ יְהוָ֑ה אִמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֗יו כָּל־ תִּשָּׂ֤א עָוֺן֙ וְקַח־ ט֔וֹב וּֽנְשַׁלְּמָ֥ה פָרִ֖ים שְׂפָתֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: qə·ḥū ‘im·mā·ḵem də·ḇā·rîm wə·šū·ḇū ’el- Yah·weh ’im·rū ’ê·lāw kāl- tiś·śā ‘ā·wōn wə·qaḥ- ṭō·wḇ ū·nə·šal·lə·māh p̄ā·rîm śə·p̄ā·ṯê·nū
verses.literal: Bring your confessions and return to the LORD Say to Him Take away all our iniquity and receive us graciously that we may present the fruit of our lips
verses.literalPt: Tomai convosco palavras e voltai para Jeová; dizei-lhe: Tira toda a iniquidade e aceita o que é bom; assim, ofereceremos como novilhos as ofertas dos nossos lábios.

verses.original: אַשּׁ֣וּר׀ לֹ֣א יוֹשִׁיעֵ֗נוּ עַל־ סוּס֙ לֹ֣א נִרְכָּ֔ב וְלֹא־ נֹ֥אמַר ע֛וֹד אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ לְמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָדֵ֑ינוּ אֲשֶׁר־ בְּךָ֖ יְרֻחַ֥ם יָתֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: ’aš·šūr lō yō·wō·šî·‘ê·nū ‘al- sūs lō nir·kāḇ wə·lō- nō·mar ‘ō·wḏ ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū lə·ma·‘ă·śêh yā·ḏê·nū ’ă·šer- bə·ḵā yə·ru·ḥam yā·ṯō·wm
verses.literal: Assyria will not save us nor will we ride on horses We will never again . . . say Our gods to the work of our own hands For in You the fatherless find compassion
verses.literalPt: Assur não nos salvará; não montaremos em cavalos, nem diremos mais à obra das nossas mãos: Vós sois nossos deuses, porque em ti o órfão acha a misericórdia.

verses.original: אֶרְפָּא֙ מְשׁ֣וּבָתָ֔ם אֹהֲבֵ֖ם נְדָבָ֑ה כִּ֛י שָׁ֥ב אַפִּ֖י מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.literal: I will heal their apostasy I will freely love them for My anger has turned away from them
verses.literalPt: Curarei a sua apostasia, amá-los-ei voluntariamente, porque a minha ira está apartada deles.

verses.original: אֶהְיֶ֤ה כַטַּל֙ לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יִפְרַ֖ח כַּשּֽׁוֹשַׁנָּ֑ה וְיַ֥ךְ שָׁרָשָׁ֖יו כַּלְּבָנֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ’eh·yeh ḵaṭ·ṭal lə·yiś·rā·’êl yip̄·raḥ kaš·šō·wō·šan·nāh wə·yaḵ šā·rā·šāw kal·lə·ḇā·nō·wn
verses.literal: I will be like the dew to Israel he will blossom like the lily and take root like the cedars of Lebanon
verses.literalPt: Serei para Israel como o orvalho; ele brotará como o lírio e lançará as suas raízes como o Líbano.

verses.original: יֵֽלְכוּ֙ יֹֽנְקוֹתָ֔יו וִיהִ֥י כַזַּ֖יִת הוֹד֑וֹ וְרֵ֥יחַֽ ל֖וֹ כַּלְּבָנֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: yê·lə·ḵū yō·nə·qō·w·ṯāw wî·hî ḵaz·za·yiṯ hō·w·ḏōw wə·rê·aḥ lōw kal·lə·ḇā·nō·wn
verses.literal: His shoots will sprout and his splendor will be like the olive tree his fragrance like the cedars of Lebanon
verses.literalPt: Estender-se-ão os seus ramos, e a sua formosura será como a oliveira, e o seu cheiro, como o Líbano.

verses.original: יָשֻׁ֙בוּ֙ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י בְצִלּ֔וֹ יְחַיּ֥וּ דָגָ֖ן וְיִפְרְח֣וּ כַגָּ֑פֶן זִכְר֖וֹ כְּיֵ֥ין לְבָנֽוֹן׃ס
verses.transliteration: yā·šu·ḇū yō·šə·ḇê ḇə·ṣil·lōw yə·ḥay·yū ḏā·ḡān wə·yip̄·rə·ḥū ḵag·gā·p̄en ziḵ·rōw kə·yên lə·ḇā·nō·wn
verses.literal: They will return and dwell in his shade they will grow grain and blossom like the vine His renown will be like the wine of Lebanon
verses.literalPt: Os que habitam debaixo da sua sombra voltarão; reverdecerão como trigo e brotarão como a vide; e o seu cheiro será como o vinho do Líbano.

verses.original: אֶפְרַ֕יִם מַה־ לִּ֥י ע֖וֹד לָֽעֲצַבִּ֑ים אֲנִ֧י עָנִ֣יתִי וַאֲשׁוּרֶ֗נּוּ אֲנִי֙ כִּבְר֣וֹשׁ רַֽעֲנָ֔ן מִמֶּ֖נִּי פֶּרְיְךָ֥ נִמְצָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ’ep̄·ra·yim mah- lî ‘ō·wḏ lā·‘ă·ṣab·bîm ’ă·nî ‘ā·nî·ṯî wa·’ă·šū·ren·nū ’ă·nî kiḇ·rō·wōš ra·‘ă·nān mim·men·nî per·yə·ḵā nim·ṣā
verses.literal: O Ephraim what have I to do anymore with idols It is I who answer and watch over him I am like a flourishing cypress your fruit comes from Me
verses.literalPt: Efraim dirá: Que tenho eu mais com os ídolos? Eu tenho respondido e atentarei para ele; eu sou como cipreste verde; de mim acha-se o teu fruto.

verses.original: מִ֤י חָכָם֙ וְיָ֣בֵֽן אֵ֔לֶּה נָב֖וֹן וְיֵֽדָעֵ֑ם כִּֽי־ יְשָׁרִ֞ים דַּרְכֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה וְצַדִּקִים֙ יֵ֣לְכוּ בָ֔ם וּפֹשְׁעִ֖ים יִכָּ֥שְׁלוּ בָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: mî ḥā·ḵām wə·yā·ḇên ’êl·leh nā·ḇō·wn wə·yê·ḏā·‘êm kî- yə·šā·rîm dar·ḵê Yah·weh wə·ṣad·di·qîm yê·lə·ḵū ḇām ū·p̄ō·šə·‘îm yik·kā·šə·lū ḇām
verses.literal: Whoever is wise let him understand these things whoever is discerning let him know them For the ways of the LORD are right and the righteous walk in them but the rebellious stumble in them
verses.literalPt: Quem é sábio e entenderá essas coisas? Prudente e as conhecerá? Porque os caminhos de Jeová são direitos, e os justos andarão neles; mas os transgressores cairão neles.
